newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe, Hecla complete Rosebud deal.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe, Hecla complete Rosebud deal.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp and Hecla Mining Co said on Tuesday that a final agreement for the Rosebud project has been signed.
The 50/50 joint venture will develop the Rosebud gold property, which is an underground, high-grade oxide gold deposit located 50 miles west of Winnemucca, Nev., the companies said.
The mine will be operated by Hecla and ore will be processed at Santa Fe's Twin Creeks Mine, the companies said in a joint statement.
The Rosebud mine is expected to produce an average of about 100,000 ounces of gold annually for five years and initial production is anticipated in the second quarter of 1997, the companies said.
